action: Preserve v1r18 unchanged as a completed autonomous scientific run that exposed a generic publication-readiness framework defect. Strengthen manuscript generation to target a full 5-page IEEE paper and publication validation to require a substantive 4-5 page final manuscript plus verified handling of required peer-review revisions. Any subsequent final paper run must start fresh from the original frozen scientific inputs and must not reuse v1r18 scientific choices or results.
diagnosis: The publication-readiness validator enforced only the maximum conference page limit (page_count <= 5) and therefore allowed a severely underfilled 2-page manuscript to receive Ready=True. The framework also permitted finalisation although required reviewer revisions were not represented with sufficient technical depth in the compiled manuscript.
observed_failure: The autonomous scientific run completed successfully and all scientific execution, analysis, reconciliation, reference, review, disclosure, and compilation gates passed. However, the final IEEE manuscript occupied only 2 pages despite a 5-page conference budget. The autonomous peer review also requested substantive additions including ceiling-effect diagnostics, concrete verifier-feedback examples, reproducibility guidance, and expanded limitations.
